name: email-spam-filter
description: ADVISORY LLM spam triage: classify an inbound email (spam/ham + confidence) and RECOMMEND deliver vs quarantine. Fail-safe delivery gate (explicit ham AND confidence >= 0.85). NOTE: LLM content classifiers can be manipulated by crafted email (prompt injection) — the verdict is advisory only, never an authenticated delivery gate; combine with SPF/DKIM/DMARC.

steps.description: Fail-safe advisory routing: recommend DELIVER only for a high-confidence ham verdict; otherwise recommend QUARANTINE.
steps.run:
set -o pipefail; jq -c '
  def sane: (. // "" | tostring | gsub("[[:cntrl:]]+"; " ") | gsub("[   ]+"; " "));
  (((.classify.confidence)) | if type=="number" then . else -1 end) as $conf |
  (((.classify.label) == "ham") and ($conf >= 0.85) and ($conf <= 1.0)) as $deliver |
  {
    action: (if $deliver then "DELIVER" else "QUARANTINE" end),
    label: ((.classify.label // "(none)") | tostring),
    confidence: $conf,
    sender:  (.sender  | sane),
    subject: ((.subject // "(no subject)") | sane),
    reason:  ((.classify.reason // "?") | sane),
    advisory: "LLM assessment of attacker-controlled content — ADVISORY only, not an authenticated gate. An attacker can influence the classification (prompt injection). Combine with SPF/DKIM/DMARC before delivery. The authoritative decision is the `action` field; sender/subject/reason are display-only and sanitized."
  }
' <<< "$OSL_CONTEXT"
